releases.notes:
This is the first official stable release of the mod with all (most) original features implemented! 

# Working Features
- All players start with 5 lives
- Players lose a life when they die
- Player names turn light green at 3 lives
- Player names turn yellow at 2 lives
- Player names turn red at 1 life
- Yellow players can regain a life by killing a player with 4+ lives
- Red players can regain a life by killing any player
- Red players are put in spectator when they die
- Forces game rules:
  - difficulty set to hard
  - keep inventory on
  - world border at 500
  - spawn radius 0
- Custom recipes:
  - saddles can be made with leather
  - leather can be smelted from rotten flesh
  - monster spawners can be crafted using iron, rotten flesh, diamond, and bone
  - tnt can be crafted using paper instead of sand
- Custom drops:
  - spawn eggs can drop from creepers, drowned, skeletons, spiders, and zombies
- Custom enchantment rolls:
  - all non-curse villager enchanted book trades removed
  - enchanting table rebalanced to include essential treasure enchants
  - range of available enchantments reduced
- Custom in game advancements

## Base Supported Features
- scoreboard teams for name coloring
- all players start with 5 lives
- players names shift to light green at 3 lives
- players names turn yellow at 2 lives
- players with 2 lives may kill players with 4 or 5 lives to regain a life
- players names turn red at 1 life
- players with 1 life may kill any player to regain a life
- players with no lives remaining are put in spectator mode
- `/lives` command to view your current life count
- `/givelife <player>` command to give a life, usable once per session
- `/setlives <player> <lives>` command (OP only) to manually set player life count

readmeSummary: Survivors is a custom game mode based on Grain's Third Life series on YouTube. The mod introduces a life system that creates a semi-hardcore game.
